reason: Twenty-two thousand is most of a month's salary for a machine to do what my family's hands already do for free. In a normal week I am not spending that; at most I would look again at Diwali or before a wedding, and only if the dealer gives a real discount or a gift.
objection: Hand-washing costs nothing and we have always done it. And I do not trust a battery to last in this heat. If it dies after the warranty, I am stuck paying the dealer for a new one.
would_change_my_mind: A festival offer that brings it to about ₹16,000 with the solar panel thrown in free, and a neighbour I know who has used one for a year without trouble.
